title: Hotel Rate Plans: Amendment Permissions and Fee Schedule
content:
Whether a reservation may be amended after it is confirmed, how often, and at what charge are contracted plan by plan across the Hotel Rate Plans range.

| Rate plan | Dates may be moved | Date change fee, USD | Maximum date changes | Lead guest may be replaced | Name change fee, USD |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | no | 0.00 | 0 | no | 0.00 |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | yes | 75.00 | 1 | no | 0.00 |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | yes | 45.00 | 2 | yes | 35.00 |
| Standard Flexible Rate | yes | 0.00 | 4 | yes | 25.00 |
| Member Flex Rate | yes | 0.00 | 4 | yes | 0.00 |
| Suite Flexible Rate | yes | 35.00 | 3 | yes | 25.00 |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | yes | 95.00 | 2 | no | 0.00 |

The first column records whether the stay dates may be moved after the reservation is confirmed; the third is the maximum number of date changes permitted on one reservation. The fourth records whether the lead guest may be replaced by another person, and the fifth the fee for doing so.

**Two readings of the same schedule.** A plan may permit a move at no charge: the Standard Flexible Rate and the Member Flex Rate both carry a date change fee of 0.00 and permit 4 moves. A plan may permit a move only at a price: the All-Inclusive Flex Rate carries the range's highest date change fee at 95.00 and permits 2. And a plan may permit nothing at all: the Non-Refundable Saver Rate permits neither a move nor a replacement of the lead guest, and carries 0 as its ceiling on moves.
